name: Shelly 3EM-63W Gen3
summary: On-breaker 3-phase/3-circuit energy meter with integrated 63 A CTs, Wi-Fi/BLE, 7-day log.

extra.blurb_conflict: listing blurb describes the 3EM-63T (flat-terminal) variant; family/KB is 63W (wire)

gotchas: Voltmeter/supply spec is 220-240 V per phase — US 120 V split-phase legs are outside spec; see Shelly Pro 3EM-3CT63 (100-260 V)
Integrated CTs are 63 A max with Ø8 mm aperture — branch circuits only, can't clamp 100-200 A service mains
Built to sit on European DIN-rail MCBs; US plug-on breaker panels won't take it as designed
Below 30 VA per channel, energy isn't accumulated (standby loads under-counted)
best_for: EU-style 3-phase sub-panel or three 230 V branch circuits ≤63 A
